subject: WP1207 self-hosted-runner assignment observability before host inspection
observed: GitHub's documented repository endpoint GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runners lists configured self-hosted runners and exposes runner id, name, OS, status, busy, ephemeral, version and labels.
For repository-scoped access, GitHub documents admin access as required; classic tokens require repo scope and fine-grained tokens require Administration repository permission (read).
GitHub documents organization runner-group APIs that expose visibility, selected repository/workflow restrictions and runner-group membership surfaces relevant to eligibility hypotheses.

The installed GitHub connector in this session rejects the repository actions/runners endpoint as an unsupported endpoint family. This is connector capability evidence only; it does not establish that no runner exists or that any runner is offline.

external_primary.source: GitHub Docs — REST API endpoints for self-hosted runners
external_primary.relevance: Defines repository runner-roster endpoint, status/busy/version/labels response fields and required read permissions.

external_primary.source: GitHub Docs — REST API endpoints for self-hosted runner groups
external_primary.relevance: Defines runner-group visibility/repository/workflow restriction surfaces that can distinguish eligibility failures.

hypothesis: A read-only GitHub runner-roster/runner-group observation can often discriminate OFFLINE/BUSY/LABEL/GROUP eligibility hypotheses before direct owner-host inspection or product-gate replay.
counterhypothesis: Repository runner-roster APIs may be unavailable to the current tool identity or insufficient for host-local listener/connectivity failure; host inspection can remain necessary after a remote status read or when the API is inaccessible.
falsifier: Attempt the documented read-only runner-roster/group read through an already-authorized GitHub surface with the required existing permissions. If unavailable, classify OBSERVABILITY_UNAVAILABLE rather than RUNNER_OFFLINE; if available, compare status/busy/labels/group eligibility against the queued job's runs-on contract.

architecture_implication.candidate: Insert optional REMOTE_RUNNER_ROSTER_OBSERVED between REGISTERED_UNKNOWN and DIRECT_HOST_INSPECTION in the transport diagnostic ladder. The stage is observational only and never becomes effect/runtime/completion authority.
architecture_implication.fail_closed_rule: API denial, unsupported connector family, 403/404 ambiguity, or missing permission produces RUNNER_STATUS_UNKNOWN, never OFFLINE.
architecture_implication.trigger4_handoff: Before owner-host inspection, use the cheapest already-authorized read-only runner-roster/group surface if one exists; otherwise retain the existing direct-host falsifier without mutating/replaying WP1207.

next_exact_action: Trigger 4 may test availability of an already-authorized read-only GitHub Actions runner-roster surface. If unavailable, keep runner state UNKNOWN and proceed to the existing read-only owner-host lifecycle inspection; do not dispatch another WP1207 job solely to diagnose transport.
